info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Petadoption Pets Fosters-v1-spec
info.description: The Pet Adoption Fosters Retrieval API enables users to access detailed information about pets available for fostering. This endpoint is designed for shelters, rescue organizations, and foster networks looking to streamline the process of finding foster homes for pets. By retrieving a list of available pets, stakeholders can effectively manage resources and ensure that animals find suitable temporary homes. This API is vital for improving pet adoption rates and fostering community involvement in animal welfare.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch a list of pets that are available for fostering. It provides details about each pet to help potential fosterers make informed decisions.

requestBody.description: This endpoint requests information related to fostering pets. The request body should include necessary details in JSON format to process the foster request effectively.
